  reckon rule_alters(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 8)
  reckon rule_witnesses(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 9)

  reckon rule_with_cause(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(rule_kind(node), rule_name(node), value, rule_from(node), rule_into(node), rule_when(node), rule_needs(node), rule_preserves(node), rule_alters(node), rule_witnesses(node))

  reckon rule_with_from(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(rule_kind(node), rule_name(node), rule_cause(node), value, rule_into(node), rule_when(node), rule_needs(node), rule_preserves(node), rule_alters(node), rule_witnesses(node))

  reckon rule_with_into(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(rule_kind(node), rule_name(node), rule_cause(node), rule_from(node), value, rule_when(node), rule_needs(node), rule_preserves(node), rule_alters(node), rule_witnesses(node))

  reckon rule_with_when(node : Sequence, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon rule_with_need(node : Sequence, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_rule_after_expression(tokens : Sequence, expression_state : Sequence, node : Sequence, clause : Text) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_body(tokens, state_index(expression_state),
      choose(clause == "when", rule_with_when(node, state_node(expression_state)),
        rule_with_preserve(node, state_node(expression_state))))

  reckon parse_rule_after_need_target(tokens : Sequence, capability : Text, target_state : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_body(tokens, state_index(target_state), rule_with_need(node, make_need(capability, state_text(target_state))))

  reckon parse_rule_after_need_capability(tokens : Sequence, capability_state : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_after_need_target(tokens, state_text(capability_state), parse_path(tokens, state_index(capability_state) + 1), node)

  reckon parse_rule_after_alter_expression(tokens : Sequence, target : Text, node : Sequence, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_rule_after_alter_target(tokens : Sequence, target_state : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_rule_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "cause",
        parse_rule_body(tokens, index + 2, rule_with_cause(node, token_text_at(tokens, index + 1))),

          parse_rule_body(tokens, index + 2, rule_with_from(node, token_text_at(tokens, index + 1))),
          choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "into",
            parse_rule_body(tokens, index + 2, rule_with_into(node, token_text_at(tokens, index + 1))),
            choose(either(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "when", token_text_at(tokens, index) == "preserve"),

  reckon make_directive(kind : Text, name : Text) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_name_list_after_path(tokens : Sequence, path_state : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_host_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text, offers : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon make_effect(name : Text, deterministic : Text, replay : Text, evidence_required : Text, description : Text, lowers_to : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), deterministic), replay), evidence_required), description), lowers_to)

  reckon effect_name(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 0)

  reckon parse_effect_after_lowers(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, list_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_effect_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "deterministic",
        parse_effect_body(tokens, index + 2, effect_with_deterministic(node, token_text_at(tokens, index + 1))),

  reckon quote_character() -> Text = char_at("\"x", 0)
  reckon slash_character() -> Text = char_at("\\x", 0)

  reckon json_escape_from(value : Text, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(value), output,
      choose(char_at(value, index) == quote_character(), json_escape_from(value, index + 1, output + slash_character() + quote_character()),
        choose(char_at(value, index) == slash_character(), json_escape_from(value, index + 1, output + slash_character() + slash_character()),
          choose(char_at(value, index) == "\n", json_escape_from(value, index + 1, output + slash_character() + "n"),
            choose(char_at(value, index) == "\r", json_escape_from(value, index + 1, output + slash_character() + "r"),
              choose(char_at(value, index) == "\t", json_escape_from(value, index + 1, output + slash_character() + "t"),
                json_escape_from(value, index + 1, output + char_at(value, index))))))))

  reckon json_quote(value : Text) -> Text = quote_character() + json_escape_from(value, 0, "") + quote_character()
  reckon json_truth(value : Text) -> Text = choose(value == "true", "true", "false")

              choose(expr_text(node) == minus_operator() or expr_text(node) == "*" or expr_text(node) == "/" or expr_text(node) == "%", "Number", "Truth")),
            choose(expr_text(node) == "choose", ui_expression_type(sequence_get(expr_args(node), 1), states, derived, parameters), "")))))

        choose(expr_kind(node) == "UnaryExpr",
          "{\"expression\":" + canonical_ui_expression(expr_left(node), states, derived, parameters) + ",\"kind\":\"unary\",\"operator\":"

          choose(expr_kind(node) == "BinaryExpr",
            "{\"kind\":\"binary\",\"left\":" + canonical_ui_expression(expr_left(node), states, derived, parameters)
              + ",\"operator\":" + json_quote(expr_text(node)) + ",\"right\":"
              + canonical_ui_expression(expr_right(node), states, derived, parameters) + ",\"valueType\":"
              + json_quote(ui_expression_type(node, states, derived, parameters)) + "}",
            "{\"args\":" + canonical_ui_expression_array(expr_args(node), 0, states, derived, parameters, "[")

          + "," + json_quote(ui_property_name(sequence_get(items, index))) + ","
          + canonical_ui_expression(ui_property_expression(sequence_get(items, index)), states, derived, empty_sequence()) + "]"))

  reckon canonical_ui_event_parameters(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_event_parameters(items, index + 1,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + "{\"id\":" + json_quote(ui_parameter_name(sequence_get(items, index)))
          + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(ui_parameter_type(sequence_get(items, index))) + "}"))

  reckon canonical_ui_event_statement(node : Sequence, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(ui_statement_kind(node) == "realize-reality",
      "{\"kind\":\"realize-reality\",\"rule\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
      choose(ui_statement_kind(node) == "navigate",
        "{\"kind\":\"navigate\",\"route\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
        choose(semantic_check(find_ui_state_type(states, 0, ui_set_target(node)) != "", "RCL_UI_EVENT_TARGET_UNKNOWN", ui_set_target(node)),
          choose(semantic_check(ui_expression_type(ui_set_expression(node), states, derived, parameters)
              == find_ui_state_type(states, 0, ui_set_target(node)), "RCL_UI_EVENT_MUTATION_TYPE", ui_set_target(node)),
            "{\"expression\":" + canonical_ui_expression(ui_set_expression(node), states, derived, parameters)
              + ",\"kind\":\"set-state\",\"target\":" + json_quote(ui_set_target(node)) + "}", ""), "")))

  reckon canonical_ui_event_statements(items : Sequence, index : Number, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_event_statements(items, index + 1, states, derived, parameters,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + canonical_ui_event_statement(sequence_get(items, index), states, derived, parameters)))

  reckon canonical_ui_events(items : Sequence, index : Number, node_id : Text, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_events(items, index + 1, node_id, states, derived,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + "[" + json_quote(node_id + ".event." + ui_event_type(sequence_get(items, index)) + "." + text(index))
          + "," + json_quote(ui_event_type(sequence_get(items, index))) + ","
          + canonical_ui_event_parameters(ui_event_parameters(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, "[") + ","
          + json_quote(choose(ui_statements_have_kind(ui_event_statements(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, "realize-reality"),
            "reality-transaction", "ui-local")) + ","
          + canonical_ui_event_statements(ui_event_statements(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, states, derived,
            ui_event_parameters(sequence_get(items, index)), "[") + "]"))

  reckon canonical_ui_size(mode : Text, value : Text) -> Text =
    "[" + json_quote(mode) + "," + choose(mode == "fixed", value, "null") + "]"

  reckon canonical_ui_layout(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    "[" + json_quote(ui_layout_mode(node)) + "," + canonical_ui_size(ui_layout_width_mode(node), ui_layout_width_value(node))
      + "," + canonical_ui_size(ui_layout_height_mode(node), ui_layout_height_value(node)) + "," + text(ui_layout_gap(node))
      + "," + text(ui_layout_padding(node)) + "," + json_quote(ui_layout_alignment(node)) + ","
      + json_quote(ui_layout_distribution(node)) + "," + json_quote(ui_layout_overflow(node)) + "," + text(ui_layout_columns(node)) + "]"

  reckon find_ui_property(items : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), empty_sequence(),
      choose(ui_property_name(sequence_get(items, index)) == name, sequence_get(items, index),
        find_ui_property(items, index + 1, name)))

  reckon ui_style_property(name : Text) -> Truth =
    name == "foreground" or name == "background" or name == "font_family" or name == "font_size"
      or name == "text_align" or name == "corner_radius" or name == "language"

  reckon ui_inherited_property(name : Text) -> Truth =
    name == "foreground" or name == "font_family" or name == "font_size" or name == "text_align" or name == "language"

  reckon ui_style_specificity(kind : Text) -> Number = choose(kind == "role", 1, choose(kind == "class", 10, 100))

  reckon ui_style_matches(style : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(ui_style_selector_kind(style) == "role", ui_style_selector_value(style) == ui_view_role(node),
      choose(ui_style_selector_kind(style) == "class", find_text(ui_view_classes(node), 0, ui_style_selector_value(style)) >= 0,
        ui_style_selector_value(style) == ui_view_id(node)))

  reckon make_resolved_property(found : Truth, value : Text, provenance : Text, score : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), found), value), provenance), score)

  reckon resolved_found(node : Sequence) -> Truth = sequence_get(node, 0)
  reckon resolved_value(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 1)
  reckon resolved_provenance(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 2)
  reckon resolved_score(node : Sequence) -> Number = sequence_get(node, 3)

  reckon resolve_ui_rules(styles : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence, property : Text, best : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(styles), best,
      resolve_ui_rules(styles, index + 1, node, property,
        choose(ui_style_matches(sequence_get(styles, index), node)
            and length(find_ui_property(ui_style_declarations(sequence_get(styles, index)), 0, property)) > 0
            and (ui_style_priority(sequence_get(styles, index)) * 10000
              + ui_style_specificity(ui_style_selector_kind(sequence_get(styles, index))) * 100
              + ui_style_order(sequence_get(styles, index))) >= resolved_score(best),
          make_resolved_property(true,
            ui_literal_json(ui_property_expression(find_ui_property(ui_style_declarations(sequence_get(styles, index)), 0, property))),
            "rule:" + ui_style_name(sequence_get(styles, index)),
            ui_style_priority(sequence_get(styles, index)) * 10000
              + ui_style_specificity(ui_style_selector_kind(sequence_get(styles, index))) * 100
              + ui_style_order(sequence_get(styles, index))), best)))

  reckon resolve_ui_property_after_rule(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, property : Text, rule : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(resolved_found(rule), rule,
      choose(length(themes) > 0 and length(find_ui_property(ui_theme_declarations(sequence_get(themes, 0)), 0, property)) > 0,
        make_resolved_property(true,
          ui_literal_json(ui_property_expression(find_ui_property(ui_theme_declarations(sequence_get(themes, 0)), 0, property))),
          "theme:" + ui_theme_name(sequence_get(themes, 0)), 0),
        make_resolved_property(false, "", "", -1)))

  reckon resolve_ui_property(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence, property : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(length(find_ui_property(ui_view_properties(node), 0, property)) > 0 and ui_style_property(property),
      make_resolved_property(true,
        ui_literal_json(ui_property_expression(find_ui_property(ui_view_properties(node), 0, property))),
        "node:" + ui_view_id(node), 1000000000),
      resolve_ui_property_after_rule(node, themes, property,
        resolve_ui_rules(styles, 0, node, property, make_resolved_property(false, "", "", -1))))

  reckon ui_style_property_names() -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "background"), "corner_radius"), "font_family"), "font_size"), "foreground"), "language"), "text_align")

  reckon canonical_resolved_object(names : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence, provenance : Truth, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(names), output + "}",
      canonical_resolved_object(names, index + 1, node, themes, styles, provenance,
        choose(resolved_found(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index))),
          output + choose(output == "{", "", ",") + json_quote(sequence_get(names, index)) + ":"
            + choose(provenance,
              json_quote(resolved_provenance(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index)))),
              resolved_value(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index)))), output)))

  reckon canonical_ui_resolved_style(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence) -> Text =
    "[" + canonical_resolved_object(ui_style_property_names(), 0, node, themes, styles, false, "{")

  reckon canonical_ui_theme_declarations(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon canonical_ui_themes(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon canonical_ui_adaptation(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(length(node) == 0, "null",

  reckon cui(node : Sequence, reality : Text) -> Text =
    "[\"rcl.native-ui.semantic-genome.v0.1\",\"rcl.native-ui.program.v0.1\",\"0.1.0\",\"UIProgram\"," + json_quote(ui_name(node))
      + "," + json_quote(reality) + "," + canonical_ui_states(ui_states(node), 0, "[") + ","
      + canonical_ui_derived(ui_derived(node), 0, ui_states(node), "[") + ","

      + canonical_ui_style_sheet(ui_themes(node), ui_styles(node)) + ",["
      + canonical_ui_texts(ui_stages(node), 0, "[") + "," + canonical_ui_texts(ui_restore(node), 0, "[")
      + "],[" + choose(length(ui_navigation(node)) == 0, "null",
        "{\"format\":\"rcl.native-ui.navigation.v0.1\",\"initialRoute\":"
          + json_quote(sequence_get(ui_navigation(node), 0)) + ",\"routes\":"

  reckon canonical_expression(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(expr_kind(node) == "LiteralExpr",
      "{\"kind\":\"LiteralExpr\",\"value\":"
        + choose(expr_text(node) == "Text", json_quote(expr_literal_text(node)),
            choose(expr_text(node) == "Truth", json_truth(expr_literal_text(node)), expr_literal_text(node)))
        + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(expr_text(node)) + "}",
      choose(expr_kind(node) == "PathExpr",
        "{\"kind\":\"PathExpr\",\"path\":" + json_quote(expr_text(node)) + "}",
        choose(expr_kind(node) == "UnaryExpr",
          "{\"expression\":" + canonical_expression(expr_left(node)) + ",\"kind\":\"UnaryExpr\",\"operator\":" + json_quote(expr_text(node)) + "}",
          choose(expr_kind(node) == "BinaryExpr",
            "{\"kind\":\"BinaryExpr\",\"left\":" + canonical_expression(expr_left(node))
              + ",\"operator\":" + json_quote(expr_text(node)) + ",\"right\":" + canonical_expression(expr_right(node)) + "}",
            "{\"args\":" + canonical_expression_array(expr_args(node), 0, "[")
              + ",\"kind\":\"CallExpr\",\"name\":" + json_quote(expr_text(node)) + "}"))))

          + "{\"name\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0))
          + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) + "}"))

      + choose(facet_owner(node) == "", "null", json_quote(facet_owner(node)))

      + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(facet_type(node)) + "}"

  reckon canonical_warrants(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon canonical_rules(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon canonical_effect(node : Sequence) -> Text =

          choose(name == "typed_ref", "Any:TypedRef", choose(name == "typed_deref", "TypedRef:Unknown", "TypedRef:Number"))), name))

  reckon predicate_user_arguments(types : Sequence, params : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(types), semantic_check(index == length(params), "RCL_SEMANTIC_CALL_ARITY", name),
      choose(semantic_check(index < length(params), "RCL_SEMANTIC_CALL_ARITY", name),
        choose(semantic_check(predicate_accepts(sequence_get(sequence_get(params, index), 1), sequence_get(types, index)),
            "RCL_CALL_TYPE", name + ":" + text(index)),
          predicate_user_arguments(types, params, index + 1, name), false), false))

  reckon predicate_function_result(actual : Text, node : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(semantic_check(predicate_accepts(reckon_return_type(node), actual), "RCL_RECKON_RETURN_TYPE", reckon_name(node)),
      reckon_return_type(node), "Unknown")

  reckon predicate_function_type(node : Sequence, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, visited : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(find_text(visited, 0, reckon_name(node)) >= 0, reckon_return_type(node),
      predicate_function_result(predicate_expression_type(reckon_expression(node), reckon_params(node), facets, reckons, sequence_append(visited, reckon_name(node))), node))

  reckon predicate_user_type(types : Sequence, node : Sequence, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, visited : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(predicate_user_arguments(types, reckon_params(node), 0, reckon_name(node)),
      predicate_function_type(node, facets, reckons, visited), "Unknown")

  reckon predicate_call_type(name : Text, types : Sequence, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, visited : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(builtin_id(name) > 0, predicate_builtin_type(types, predicate_builtin_signature(builtin_id(name)), name),
      choose(name == "choose" or name == "provider_call" or name == "typed_ref" or name == "typed_deref" or name == "typed_ref_id",
        predicate_special_call_type(name, types),
        predicate_user_type(types, sequence_get(reckons, find_reckon_index(reckons, 0, name)), facets, reckons, visited)))

  reckon predicate_unary_type(operator : Text, actual : Text) -> Text =
    choose(operator == not_operator(),
      choose(semantic_check(predicate_accepts("Truth", actual), "RCL_TYPE_UNARY", operator), "Truth", "Unknown"),
      predicate_checked_type(actual, "Number", "RCL_TYPE_UNARY", operator))

  reckon predicate_binary_type(operator : Text, left : Text, right : Text) -> Text =
    choose(operator == "and" or operator == "or",
      choose(semantic_check(predicate_accepts("Truth", left) and predicate_accepts("Truth", right), "RCL_TYPE_LOGIC", operator), "Truth", "Unknown"),
      choose(left == "Unknown" or right == "Unknown",
        choose(operator == "==" or operator == "!=" or operator == "<" or operator == "<=" or operator == ">" or operator == ">=", "Truth", "Unknown"),
        choose(operator == "==" or operator == "!=",
          choose(semantic_check(left == right, "RCL_TYPE_BINARY", operator), "Truth", "Unknown"),
          choose(operator == "<" or operator == "<=" or operator == ">" or operator == ">=",
            choose(semantic_check(left == "Number" and right == "Number", "RCL_TYPE_BINARY", operator), "Truth", "Unknown"),
            choose(operator == "+" and left == "Text" and right == "Text", "Text",
              choose(semantic_check(left == "Number" and right == "Number", "RCL_TYPE_BINARY", operator), "Number", "Unknown"))))))

  reckon predicate_expression_type(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, visited : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(expr_kind(node) == "LiteralExpr", expr_text(node),
      choose(expr_kind(node) == "PathExpr", predicate_path_type(expr_text(node), locals, facets, predicate_local_index(locals, 0, expr_text(node))),
        choose(expr_kind(node) == "UnaryExpr", predicate_unary_type(expr_text(node), predicate_expression_type(expr_left(node), locals, facets, reckons, visited)),
          choose(expr_kind(node) == "BinaryExpr",
            predicate_binary_type(expr_text(node), predicate_expression_type(expr_left(node), locals, facets, reckons, visited), predicate_expression_type(expr_right(node), locals, facets, reckons, visited)),
            predicate_call_type(expr_text(node), predicate_argument_types(expr_args(node), 0, locals, facets, reckons, visited, empty_sequence()), facets, reckons, visited)))))

  reckon validate_warrant_condition(node : Sequence, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(validate_expression(warrant_condition(node), empty_sequence(), facets, reckons),
      semantic_check(predicate_accepts("Truth", predicate_expression_type(warrant_condition(node), empty_sequence(), facets, reckons, empty_sequence())),
        "RCL_WARRANT_CONDITION_TYPE", warrant_subject(node) + ":" + warrant_capability(node)), false)

  reckon validate_warrants(items : Sequence, index : Number, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(warrant_conditional(sequence_get(items, index)),
        choose(validate_warrant_condition(sequence_get(items, index), facets, reckons), validate_warrants(items, index + 1, facets, reckons), false),
        validate_warrants(items, index + 1, facets, reckons)))

  reckon validate_facets(items : Sequence, index : Number, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(semantic_check(expr_kind(facet_expression(sequence_get(items, index))) != "LiteralExpr"
            or facet_type(sequence_get(items, index)) == expr_text(facet_expression(sequence_get(items, index))),
          "RCL_SEMANTIC_TYPE_MISMATCH", facet_path(sequence_get(items, index))),
        choose(validate_expression(facet_expression(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), facets, reckons),
          validate_facets(items, index + 1, facets, reckons), false), false))

  reckon validate_reckons(items : Sequence, index : Number, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(validate_expression(reckon_expression(sequence_get(items, index)),
          param_names(reckon_params(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, empty_sequence()), facets, reckons),
        validate_reckons(items, index + 1, facets, reckons), false))

  reckon validate_alters(items : Sequence, index : Number, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(semantic_check(find_facet_index(facets, 0, alter_target(sequence_get(items, index))) >= 0,
          "RCL_SEMANTIC_UNKNOWN_ALTER_TARGET", alter_target(sequence_get(items, index))),
        choose(validate_expression(alter_expression(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), facets, reckons),
          validate_alters(items, index + 1, facets, reckons), false), false))

  reckon validate_rules(items : Sequence, index : Number, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(validate_expression(rule_when(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), facets, reckons),
        choose(validate_alters(rule_alters(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, facets, reckons),
          choose(validate_expression_array(rule_preserves(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, empty_sequence(), facets, reckons),
            validate_rules(items, index + 1, facets, reckons), false), false), false))

  reckon find_ui_rule_index(items : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(rule_name(sequence_get(items, index)) == name, index, find_ui_rule_index(items, index + 1, name)))

  reckon validate_ui_event_statements(items : Sequence, index : Number, node_id : Text, event_type : Text, rules : Sequence, navigation : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(ui_statement_kind(sequence_get(items, index)) == "realize-reality",
        choose(semantic_check(find_ui_rule_index(rules, 0, sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) >= 0,
            "RCL_UI_REALITY_RULE_UNKNOWN", node_id + ":" + sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)),
          validate_ui_event_statements(items, index + 1, node_id, event_type, rules, navigation), false),
        choose(ui_statement_kind(sequence_get(items, index)) == "navigate",
          choose(semantic_check(length(navigation) > 0, "RCL_UI_NAVIGATION_REQUIRED", node_id + ":" + event_type),
            choose(semantic_check(find_text(sequence_get(navigation, 1), 0,
                  sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) >= 0,
                "RCL_UI_NAVIGATION_ROUTE_UNKNOWN", node_id + ":" + event_type + ":" + sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)),
              validate_ui_event_statements(items, index + 1, node_id, event_type, rules, navigation), false), false),
          validate_ui_event_statements(items, index + 1, node_id, event_type, rules, navigation))))

  reckon validate_ui_events(items : Sequence, index : Number, node_id : Text, rules : Sequence, navigation : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(validate_ui_event_statements(ui_event_statements(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, node_id,
          ui_event_type(sequence_get(items, index)), rules, navigation),
        validate_ui_events(items, index + 1, node_id, rules, navigation), false))

  reckon validate_ui_adaptive_layouts(items : Sequence, index : Number, node_id : Text, adaptation : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(semantic_check(length(adaptation) > 0, "RCL_UI_DEVICE_ADAPTATION_REQUIRED", node_id),
        choose(semantic_check(find_text(sequence_get(adaptation, 1), 0,
              sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)) >= 0,
            "RCL_UI_DEVICE_ADAPTATION_PROFILE_UNKNOWN", node_id + ":" + sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)),
          validate_ui_adaptive_layouts(items, index + 1, node_id, adaptation), false), false))

  reckon validate_ui_node(node : Sequence, rules : Sequence, navigation : Sequence, adaptation : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(validate_ui_events(ui_view_events(node), 0, ui_view_id(node), rules, navigation),
      choose(validate_ui_adaptive_layouts(ui_view_adaptive_layouts(node), 0, ui_view_id(node), adaptation),
        validate_ui_nodes(ui_view_children(node), 0, rules, navigation, adaptation), false), false)

  reckon validate_ui_nodes(items : Sequence, index : Number, rules : Sequence, navigation : Sequence, adaptation : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(validate_ui_node(sequence_get(items, index), rules, navigation, adaptation),
        validate_ui_nodes(items, index + 1, rules, navigation, adaptation), false))

  reckon find_ui_direct_child(items : Sequence, index : Number, id : Text) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(ui_view_id(sequence_get(items, index)) == id, index, find_ui_direct_child(items, index + 1, id)))

  reckon validate_ui_route_targets(ids : Sequence, targets : Sequence, index : Number, root : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(ids), true,
      choose(semantic_check(find_ui_direct_child(ui_view_children(root), 0,
            sequence_get(targets, index)) >= 0,
          "RCL_UI_NAVIGATION_TARGET_UNKNOWN", sequence_get(ids, index) + ":" + sequence_get(targets, index)),
        validate_ui_route_targets(ids, targets, index + 1, root), false))

  reckon validate_uis(items : Sequence, index : Number, rules : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(length(ui_navigation(sequence_get(items, index))) == 0,
        choose(validate_ui_nodes(ui_views(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, rules, ui_navigation(sequence_get(items, index)), ui_adaptation(sequence_get(items, index))),
          validate_uis(items, index + 1, rules), false),
        choose(semantic_check(find_text(sequence_get(ui_navigation(sequence_get(items, index)), 1), 0,
              sequence_get(ui_navigation(sequence_get(items, index)), 0)) >= 0,
            "RCL_UI_NAVIGATION_INITIAL_UNKNOWN", sequence_get(ui_navigation(sequence_get(items, index)), 0)),
          choose(validate_ui_route_targets(sequence_get(ui_navigation(sequence_get(items, index)), 1),
              sequence_get(ui_navigation(sequence_get(items, index)), 2), 0, sequence_get(ui_views(sequence_get(items, index)), 0)),
            choose(validate_ui_nodes(ui_views(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, rules, ui_navigation(sequence_get(items, index)), ui_adaptation(sequence_get(items, index))),
              validate_uis(items, index + 1, rules), false), false), false)))

  reckon validate_program(program : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(validate_facets(program_facets(program), 0, program_facets(program), program_reckons(program)),
      choose(validate_reckons(program_reckons(program), 0, program_facets(program), program_reckons(program)),
        choose(validate_warrants(program_warrants(program), 0, program_facets(program), program_reckons(program)),
          choose(validate_rules(program_rules(program), 0, program_facets(program), program_reckons(program)),
            validate_uis(uis(program), 0, program_rules(program)), false), false), false), false)

  reckon validated_program(program : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(validate_program(program), program, program)

  reckon param_names(params : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(params), output,
      param_names(params, index + 1, sequence_append(output, sequence_get(sequence_get(params, index), 0))))

  reckon collect_expression_strings(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(expr_kind(node) == "LiteralExpr",
      choose(expr_text(node) == "Text", append_unique_text(output, expr_literal_text(node)), output),
      choose(expr_kind(node) == "PathExpr",
        choose(find_text(locals, 0, expr_text(node)) >= 0, output, append_unique_text(output, expr_text(node))),
        choose(expr_kind(node) == "UnaryExpr",
          collect_expression_strings(expr_left(node), locals, output),
          choose(expr_kind(node) == "BinaryExpr",
            collect_expression_strings(expr_right(node), locals,
              collect_expression_strings(expr_left(node), locals, output)),
            collect_expression_strings_array(expr_args(node), 0, locals, output)))))

  reckon collect_expression_strings_array(items : Sequence, index : Number, locals : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_expression_strings_array(items, index + 1, locals,
        collect_expression_strings(sequence_get(items, index), locals, output)))

  reckon collect_expression_numbers(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(expr_kind(node) == "LiteralExpr",
      choose(expr_text(node) == "Number", append_unique_number(output, number_from_text(expr_literal_text(node))), output),
      choose(expr_kind(node) == "PathExpr", output,
        choose(expr_kind(node) == "UnaryExpr", collect_expression_numbers(expr_left(node), locals, output),
          choose(expr_kind(node) == "BinaryExpr",
            collect_expression_numbers(expr_right(node), locals,
              collect_expression_numbers(expr_left(node), locals, output)),
            collect_expression_numbers_array(expr_args(node), 0, locals, output)))))

  reckon collect_expression_numbers_array(items : Sequence, index : Number, locals : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_expression_numbers_array(items, index + 1, locals,
        collect_expression_numbers(sequence_get(items, index), locals, output)))

  reckon collect_facet_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_facet_strings(items, index + 1,
        append_unique_text(collect_expression_strings(facet_expression(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), output),
          facet_path(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon collect_facet_numbers(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_facet_numbers(items, index + 1,
        collect_expression_numbers(facet_expression(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), output)))

  reckon collect_warrant_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_warrant_strings(items, index + 1,
        append_unique_text(
          append_unique_text(append_unique_text(output, warrant_subject(sequence_get(items, index))),
            warrant_capability(sequence_get(items, index))), warrant_target(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon find_rule(items : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(rule_name(sequence_get(items, index)) == name, sequence_get(items, index),
      find_rule(items, index + 1, name))

  reckon rule_actor(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(rule_kind(node) == "Emergence", rule_cause(node), rule_from(node))

  reckon collect_need_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_need_strings(items, index + 1,
        append_unique_text(append_unique_text(output, need_capability(sequence_get(items, index))),
          need_target(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon collect_alter_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, reckons : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_alter_strings(items, index + 1, reckons,
        append_unique_text(
          collect_expression_strings(alter_expression(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), output),
          alter_target(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon collect_rule_strings(node : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    collect_expression_strings_array(rule_preserves(node), 0, empty_sequence(),
      collect_alter_strings(rule_alters(node), 0, reckons,
        collect_need_strings(rule_needs(node), 0,
          append_unique_text(
            append_unique_text(collect_expression_strings(rule_when(node), empty_sequence(), output), rule_name(node)),
            rule_actor(node)))))

  reckon collect_witness_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_witness_strings(items, index + 1, append_unique_text(output, sequence_get(items, index))))

  reckon collect_rule_strings_complete(node : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    collect_witness_strings(rule_witnesses(node), 0, collect_rule_strings(node, reckons, output))

  reckon collect_directive_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, rules : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_directive_strings(items, index + 1, rules, reckons,
        collect_rule_strings_complete(find_rule(rules, 0, directive_name(sequence_get(items, index))), reckons, output)))

  reckon collect_alter_numbers(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_alter_numbers(items, index + 1,
        collect_expression_numbers(alter_expression(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), output)))

  reckon collect_rule_numbers(node : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    collect_expression_numbers_array(rule_preserves(node), 0, empty_sequence(),
      collect_alter_numbers(rule_alters(node), 0,
        collect_expression_numbers(rule_when(node), empty_sequence(), output)))

  reckon collect_directive_numbers(items : Sequence, index : Number, rules : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_directive_numbers(items, index + 1, rules,
        collect_rule_numbers(find_rule(rules, 0, directive_name(sequence_get(items, index))), output)))

  reckon collect_reckon_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_reckon_strings(items, index + 1,
        collect_expression_strings(reckon_expression(sequence_get(items, index)),
          param_names(reckon_params(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, empty_sequence()), output)))

  reckon collect_reckon_numbers(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_reckon_numbers(items, index + 1,
        collect_expression_numbers(reckon_expression(sequence_get(items, index)),
          param_names(reckon_params(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, empty_sequence()), output)))

  reckon build_string_pool(program : Sequence, root : Text) -> Sequence =
    collect_reckon_strings(program_reckons(program), 0,
      choose(has_conditional_warrants(program_warrants(program), 0),
        collect_dynamic_directive_strings(program_directives(program), 0, program_rules(program), program_reckons(program), program_warrants(program),
          collect_facet_strings(program_facets(program), 0, append_unique_text(append_unique_text(empty_sequence(), program_name(program)), root))),
        collect_directive_strings(program_directives(program), 0, program_rules(program), program_reckons(program),
          collect_warrant_strings(program_warrants(program), 0,
            collect_facet_strings(program_facets(program), 0, append_unique_text(append_unique_text(empty_sequence(), program_name(program)), root))))))

  reckon build_number_pool(program : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    collect_reckon_numbers(program_reckons(program), 0,
      choose(has_conditional_warrants(program_warrants(program), 0),
        collect_dynamic_directive_numbers(program_directives(program), 0, program_rules(program), program_warrants(program), collect_facet_numbers(program_facets(program), 0, empty_sequence())),
        collect_directive_numbers(program_directives(program), 0, program_rules(program), collect_facet_numbers(program_facets(program), 0, empty_sequence()))))

  reckon has_conditional_warrants(items : Sequence, index : Number) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), false,
      choose(warrant_conditional(sequence_get(items, index)), true, has_conditional_warrants(items, index + 1)))

  reckon collect_dynamic_warrant_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_dynamic_warrant_strings(items, index + 1,
        append_unique_text(append_unique_text(append_unique_text(
          choose(warrant_conditional(sequence_get(items, index)), collect_expression_strings(warrant_condition(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), output), output),
          warrant_subject(sequence_get(items, index))), warrant_capability(sequence_get(items, index))), warrant_target(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon collect_dynamic_warrant_numbers(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_dynamic_warrant_numbers(items, index + 1,
        choose(warrant_conditional(sequence_get(items, index)), collect_expression_numbers(warrant_condition(sequence_get(items, index)), empty_sequence(), output), output)))

  reckon collect_dynamic_directive_strings(items : Sequence, index : Number, rules : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_dynamic_directive_strings(items, index + 1, rules, reckons, warrants,
        collect_rule_strings_complete(find_rule(rules, 0, directive_name(sequence_get(items, index))), reckons, collect_dynamic_warrant_strings(warrants, 0, output))))

  reckon collect_dynamic_directive_numbers(items : Sequence, index : Number, rules : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      collect_dynamic_directive_numbers(items, index + 1, rules, warrants,
        collect_rule_numbers(find_rule(rules, 0, directive_name(sequence_get(items, index))), collect_dynamic_warrant_numbers(warrants, 0, output))))

        choose(expr_kind(node) == "BinaryExpr",

          one_instruction(4, find_text(strings, 0, expr_text(node)), 0, 0)),

          append_all(one_instruction(choose(expr_text(node) == not_operator(), 18, 19), 0, 0, 0),
            emit_expression(expr_left(node), locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start)),
          choose(expr_kind(node) == "BinaryExpr",

  reckon encode_string_record(value : Text) -> Sequence =

  reckon encode_instruction(node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_concat(bytes_u8(sequence_get(node, 0)),
      sequence_concat(bytes_u8(choose(length(node) > 4, sequence_get(node, 4), 0)),
        sequence_concat(bytes_u16le(0),
          sequence_concat(bytes_i32le(sequence_get(node, 1)),
            sequence_concat(bytes_i32le(sequence_get(node, 2)), bytes_i32le(sequence_get(node, 3)))))))

  reckon encode_instructions(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =

      encode_instructions(items, index + 1, sequence_concat(output, encode_instruction(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon instruction_flags(node : Sequence) -> Number = choose(length(node) > 4, sequence_get(node, 4), 0)

  reckon instructions_require_v12(items : Sequence, index : Number) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), false,
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == 44
          or (sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == 35 and instruction_flags(sequence_get(items, index)) == 1),
        true, instructions_require_v12(items, index + 1)))

  reckon instructions_require_v13(items : Sequence, index : Number) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), false,
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) >= 45
          or (sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == 22 and instruction_flags(sequence_get(items, index)) == 1),
        true, instructions_require_v13(items, index + 1)))

  reckon encode_header(program_index : Number, root_index : Number, string_count : Number, number_count : Number, instruction_count : Number, minor : Number) -> Sequence =
    encode_header_with_flags(program_index, root_index, string_count, number_count, instruction_count, minor, 0)

  reckon encode_header_with_flags(program_index : Number, root_index : Number, string_count : Number, number_count : Number, instruction_count : Number, minor : Number, flags : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_concat(utf8_bytes("RCLB"),
      sequence_concat(bytes_u16le(1),
        sequence_concat(bytes_u16le(minor),
          sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(flags),
            sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(program_index),
              sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(root_index),
                sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(string_count),
                  sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(number_count),
                    sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(instruction_count), bytes_u32le(0))))))))))

  reckon encode_rbc(program : Sequence, root : Text, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, instructions : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_concat(
      encode_header(find_text(strings, 0, program_name(program)), find_text(strings, 0, root),
        length(strings), length(numbers), length(instructions), choose(instructions_require_v13(instructions, 0), 3, choose(instructions_require_v12(instructions, 0), 2, 1))),
      sequence_concat(encode_string_pool(strings, 0, empty_sequence()),
        sequence_concat(encode_number_pool(numbers, 0, empty_sequence()),
          encode_instructions(instructions, 0, empty_sequence()))))

  reckon k337_scope_matches(granted : Text, required : Text) -> Truth =
    choose(granted == "*", true,
      choose(granted == required, true, starts_with(required, granted + ".")))

  reckon k337_warrant_matches(node : Sequence, actor : Text, need : Sequence) -> Truth =
    warrant_subject(node) == actor
      and warrant_capability(node) == need_capability(need)
      and k337_scope_matches(warrant_target(node), need_target(need))

  reckon k337_warrant_exists(items : Sequence, index : Number, actor : Text, need : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), false,
      choose(k337_warrant_matches(sequence_get(items, index), actor, need), true,
        k337_warrant_exists(items, index + 1, actor, need)))

  reckon k337_validate_rule_needs(items : Sequence, index : Number, warrants : Sequence, actor : Text, name : Text) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(actor == "", k337_validate_rule_needs(items, index + 1, warrants, actor, name),
        choose(semantic_check(k337_warrant_exists(warrants, 0, actor, sequence_get(items, index)),
            "RCL_WARRANT_MISSING", name + ":" + actor + ":" + need_capability(sequence_get(items, index)) + ":" + need_target(sequence_get(items, index))),
          k337_validate_rule_needs(items, index + 1, warrants, actor, name), false)))

  reckon k337_validate_rules(items : Sequence, index : Number, warrants : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(k337_validate_rule_needs(rule_needs(sequence_get(items, index)), 0, warrants,
          rule_actor(sequence_get(items, index)), rule_name(sequence_get(items, index))),
        k337_validate_rules(items, index + 1, warrants), false))

  reckon k337_validated_program(program : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(k337_validate_rules(program_rules(program), 0, program_warrants(program)), program, program)

  facet compiler.source : Text = provider_call("compiler_input", "source", "{}")
  facet compiler.tokens : Sequence = tokenize(compiler.source)
  facet compiler.program : Sequence = k337_validated_program(parse_program(compiler.tokens))
  facet compiler.canonical : Text = canonical_program(compiler.program)
  facet compiler.root : Text = program_root(compiler.program)
  facet compiler.strings : Sequence = build_string_pool(compiler.program, compiler.root)
  facet compiler.numbers : Sequence = build_number_pool(compiler.program)
  facet compiler.instructions : Sequence = build_instructions(compiler.program, compiler.strings, compiler.numbers)
  facet compiler.output : Sequence = encode_rbc(compiler.program, compiler.root, compiler.strings, compiler.numbers, compiler.instructions)
}

reality RCLGeneralSelfHostCompiler {
  facet selfhost.splice_format : Text = "rcl-open-module-v1: concatenate compiler-core.rcl, newline, compiler-main.rcl"

  reckon make_token_node(kind : Text, value : Text, line : Number, column : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), kind), value), line), column)

  reckon token_kind_at(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Text = sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens, index), 0)
  reckon token_text_at(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Text = sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens, index), 1)
  reckon token_line_at(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Number = sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens, index), 2)
  reckon token_column_at(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Number = sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens, index), 3)

  reckon token_span_at(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Span =
    make_span(0, token_line_at(tokens, index), token_column_at(tokens, index), 0)

  reckon require_token(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expected : Text, code : Text) -> Truth =
    semantic_assert(token_text_at(tokens, index) == expected, code, expected, token_span_at(tokens, index))

  reckon require_kind(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expected : Text, code : Text) -> Truth =
    semantic_assert(token_kind_at(tokens, index) == expected, code, expected, token_span_at(tokens, index))

  reckon syntax_failure(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, code : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(semantic_assert(false, code, token_text_at(tokens, index), token_span_at(tokens, index)),
      make_node_state(index, empty_sequence()), make_node_state(index, empty_sequence()))

  reckon make_text_state(index : Number, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), index), value)

  reckon make_node_state(index : Number, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), index), value)

  reckon state_index(state : Sequence) -> Number = sequence_get(state, 0)
  reckon state_text(state : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(state, 1)
  reckon state_node(state : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(state, 1)

  reckon append_all_from(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      append_all_from(items, index + 1, sequence_append(output, sequence_get(items, index))))

  reckon append_all(items : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence = append_all_from(items, 0, output)

  reckon find_text(items : Sequence, index : Number, value : Text) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(sequence_get(items, index) == value, index, find_text(items, index + 1, value)))

  reckon find_number(items : Sequence, index : Number, value : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(sequence_get(items, index) == value, index, find_number(items, index + 1, value)))

  reckon append_unique_text(items : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(find_text(items, 0, value) >= 0, items, sequence_append(items, value))

  reckon append_unique_number(items : Sequence, value : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(find_number(items, 0, value) >= 0, items, sequence_append(items, value))

  reckon either(left : Truth, right : Truth) -> Truth = choose(left, true, right)
  reckon both(left : Truth, right : Truth) -> Truth = choose(left, right, false)
  reckon minus_operator() -> Text = char_at("-x", 0)
  reckon not_operator() -> Text = slice_text("notx", 0, 3)

  reckon scan_identifier_end(source : Text, index : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(is_identifier_part(char_at(source, index)), scan_identifier_end(source, index + 1), index))

  reckon scan_number_end(source : Text, index : Number, seen_dot : Truth) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(is_digit(char_at(source, index)), scan_number_end(source, index + 1, seen_dot),
        choose(both(char_at(source, index) == char_at(".", 0), not seen_dot),
          scan_number_end(source, index + 1, true), index)))

  reckon scan_string_end(source : Text, index : Number, escaped : Truth) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(escaped, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false),
        choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\\", 0), scan_string_end(source, index + 1, true),
          choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\"", 0), index,
            scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false)))))

  reckon decoded_escape(value : Text) -> Text =
    choose(value == "n", "\n",
      choose(value == "r", "\r",
        choose(value == "t", "\t",
          choose(value == "\"", "\"", choose(value == "\\", "\\", value)))))

  reckon decode_string_from(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= end, output,
      choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\\", 0),
        decode_string_from(source, index + 2, end, output + decoded_escape(char_at(source, index + 1))),
        decode_string_from(source, index + 1, end, output + char_at(source, index))))

  reckon scan_comment_end(source : Text, index : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(char_at(source, index) == "\n", index, scan_comment_end(source, index + 1)))

  reckon position_after(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= end, sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), line), column),
      choose(char_at(source, index) == "\n",
        position_after(source, index + 1, end, line + 1, 1),
        position_after(source, index + 1, end, line, column + choose(length(utf8_bytes(char_at(source, index))) == 4, 2, 1))))

  reckon is_two_symbol(value : Text) -> Truth =
    either(value == "<-", either(value == "->", either(value == "==", either(value == "!=", either(value == "<=", value == ">=")))))

  reckon concat_token_chunks(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      concat_token_chunks(items, index + 1, sequence_concat(output, sequence_get(items, index))))

  reckon tokenize_emit(source : Text, index : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence, token : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(length(chunk) >= 127,
      tokenize_from(source, index, line, column, sequence_append(chunks, chunk),
        sequence_append(empty_sequence(), token)),
      tokenize_from(source, index, line, column, chunks, sequence_append(chunk, token)))

  reckon tokenize_from(source : Text, index : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(source),
      concat_token_chunks(sequence_append(chunks, sequence_append(chunk, make_token_node("EOF", "<eof>", line, column))), 0, empty_sequence()),
      choose(is_whitespace(char_at(source, index)),
        choose(char_at(source, index) == "\n",
          tokenize_from(source, index + 1, line + 1, 1, chunks, chunk),
          tokenize_from(source, index + 1, line, column + 1, chunks, chunk)),
        choose(either(char_at(source, index) == char_at("#", 0), slice_text(source, index, 2) == "//"),
          tokenize_from(source, scan_comment_end(source, index), line, column + scan_comment_end(source, index) - index, chunks, chunk),
          choose(is_identifier_start(char_at(source, index)),
            tokenize_emit(source, scan_identifier_end(source, index + 1), line,
              column + scan_identifier_end(source, index + 1) - index,
              chunks, chunk, make_token_node("IDENT", slice_text(source, index, scan_identifier_end(source, index + 1) - index), line, column)),
            choose(is_digit(char_at(source, index)),
              tokenize_emit(source, scan_number_end(source, index + 1, false), line,
                column + scan_number_end(source, index + 1, false) - index,
                chunks, chunk, make_token_node("NUMBER", slice_text(source, index, scan_number_end(source, index + 1, false) - index), line, column)),
              choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\"", 0),
                tokenize_emit(source, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false) + 1,
                  sequence_get(position_after(source, index, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false) + 1, line, column), 0),
                  sequence_get(position_after(source, index, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false) + 1, line, column), 1),
                  chunks, chunk, make_token_node("STRING", decode_string_from(source, index + 1, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false), ""), line, column)),
                choose(is_two_symbol(slice_text(source, index, 2)),
                  tokenize_emit(source, index + 2, line, column + 2, chunks, chunk,
                    make_token_node("SYMBOL", slice_text(source, index, 2), line, column)),
                  tokenize_emit(source, index + 1, line, column + 1, chunks, chunk,
                    make_token_node("SYMBOL", char_at(source, index), line, column)))))))))

  reckon tokenize(source : Text) -> Sequence = tokenize_from(source, 0, 1, 1, empty_sequence(), empty_sequence())

  reckon parse_path_tail(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == ".",
      parse_path_tail(tokens, index + 2, value + "." + token_text_at(tokens, index + 1)),
      make_text_state(index, value))

  reckon parse_path(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_path_tail(tokens, index + 1, token_text_at(tokens, index))

  reckon literal_node(value_type : Text, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "LiteralExpr"), value_type), value)

  reckon path_node(path : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "PathExpr"), path)

  reckon unary_node(operator : Text, expression : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "UnaryExpr"), operator), expression)

  reckon binary_node(operator : Text, left : Sequence, right : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "BinaryExpr"), operator), left), right)

  reckon call_node(name : Text, args : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "CallExpr"), name), args)

  reckon expr_kind(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 0)
  reckon expr_text(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 1)
  reckon expr_literal_text(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 2)
  reckon expr_left(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 2)
  reckon expr_right(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 3)
  reckon expr_args(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 2)

  reckon binary_precedence(operator : Text) -> Number =
    choose(operator == "or", 1,
      choose(operator == "and", 2,
        choose(either(operator == "==", operator == "!="), 3,
          choose(either(operator == "<", either(operator == "<=", either(operator == ">", operator == ">="))), 4,
            choose(either(operator == "+", operator == minus_operator()), 5,
              choose(either(operator == "*", either(operator == "/", operator == "%")), 6, 0))))))

  reckon parse_call_args(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == ")", make_node_state(index + 1, output),
      parse_call_args_after(tokens, parse_expression(tokens, index, 0), output))

  reckon parse_call_args_after(tokens : Sequence, item_state : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, state_index(item_state)) == ",",
      parse_call_args(tokens, state_index(item_state) + 1, sequence_append(output, state_node(item_state))),
      make_node_state(state_index(item_state) + 1, sequence_append(output, state_node(item_state))))

  reckon parse_prefix(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(either(token_text_at(tokens, index) == not_operator(), token_text_at(tokens, index) == minus_operator()),
      parse_unary_after(tokens, index, parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, 7)),
      choose(token_kind_at(tokens, index) == "NUMBER",
        make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Number", text(number_from_text(token_text_at(tokens, index))))),
        choose(token_kind_at(tokens, index) == "STRING",
          make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Text", token_text_at(tokens, index))),
          choose(either(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "true", token_text_at(tokens, index) == "false"),
            make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Truth", token_text_at(tokens, index))),
            choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "(",
              parse_parenthesized_after(parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, 0)),
              parse_identifier_expression(tokens, parse_path(tokens, index)))))))

  reckon parse_unary_after(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(state_index(expression_state), unary_node(token_text_at(tokens, index), state_node(expression_state)))

  reckon parse_parenthesized_after(expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(state_index(expression_state) + 1, state_node(expression_state))

  reckon parse_identifier_expression(tokens : Sequence, path_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, state_index(path_state)) == "(",
      parse_identifier_call_after(state_text(path_state), parse_call_args(tokens, state_index(path_state) + 1, empty_sequence())),
      make_node_state(state_index(path_state), path_node(state_text(path_state))))

  reckon parse_identifier_call_after(name : Text, args_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(state_index(args_state), call_node(name, state_node(args_state)))

  reckon parse_binary_tail(tokens : Sequence, left : Sequence, index : Number, minimum : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(either(binary_precedence(token_text_at(tokens, index)) < minimum, binary_precedence(token_text_at(tokens, index)) == 0),
      make_node_state(index, left),
      parse_binary_right(tokens, left, index, minimum,
        parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, binary_precedence(token_text_at(tokens, index)) + 1)))

  reckon parse_binary_right(tokens : Sequence, left : Sequence, operator_index : Number, minimum : Number, right_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_binary_tail(tokens,
      binary_node(token_text_at(tokens, operator_index), left, state_node(right_state)),
      state_index(right_state), minimum)

  reckon parse_expression(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, minimum : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_expression_after_prefix(tokens, minimum, parse_prefix(tokens, index))

  reckon parse_expression_after_prefix(tokens : Sequence, minimum : Number, prefix_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_binary_tail(tokens, state_node(prefix_state), state_index(prefix_state), minimum)

  reckon make_param(name : Text, value_type : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), value_type)

  reckon parse_params(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == ")", make_node_state(index + 1, output),
      parse_param_type(tokens, index, parse_path(tokens, index + 2), output))

  reckon parse_param_type(tokens : Sequence, name_index : Number, type_state : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, state_index(type_state)) == ",",
      parse_params(tokens, state_index(type_state) + 1,
        sequence_append(output, make_param(token_text_at(tokens, name_index), state_text(type_state)))),
      make_node_state(state_index(type_state) + 1,
        sequence_append(output, make_param(token_text_at(tokens, name_index), state_text(type_state)))))

  reckon make_facet(path : Text, value_type : Text, expression : Sequence, owner : Text, line : Number, column : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), path), value_type), expression), owner), line), column)

  reckon facet_path(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 0)
  reckon facet_type(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 1)
  reckon facet_expression(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 2)
  reckon facet_owner(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 3)
  reckon facet_line(node : Sequence) -> Number = sequence_get(node, 4)
  reckon facet_column(node : Sequence) -> Number = sequence_get(node, 5)
  reckon facet_input(node : Sequence) -> Truth = choose(length(node) > 6, sequence_get(node, 6), false)
  reckon mark_input(node : Sequence, input : Truth) -> Sequence = choose(input, sequence_append(node, true), node)

  reckon make_reckon(name : Text, params : Sequence, return_type : Text, expression : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(
      sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), params), return_type), expression),
      expression_count(expression))

  reckon reckon_name(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 0)
  reckon reckon_params(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 1)
  reckon reckon_return_type(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 2)
  reckon reckon_expression(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 3)
  reckon reckon_instruction_count(node : Sequence) -> Number = sequence_get(node, 4)

  reckon parse_facet_after_path(tokens : Sequence, start : Number, path_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_facet_after_type(tokens, start, state_text(path_state), parse_path(tokens, state_index(path_state) + 1))

  reckon parse_facet_after_type(tokens : Sequence, start : Number, path : Text, type_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_facet_after_expression(tokens, start, path, state_text(type_state),
      parse_expression(tokens, state_index(type_state) + 1, 0))

  reckon parse_facet_after_expression(tokens : Sequence, start : Number, path : Text, value_type : Text, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(state_index(expression_state),
      mark_input(make_facet(path, value_type, state_node(expression_state), "", token_line_at(tokens, start), token_column_at(tokens, start)), token_text_at(tokens, start) == "input"))

  reckon parse_facet(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_facet_after_path(tokens, index, parse_path(tokens, index + 1))

  reckon parse_reckon_after_params(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, params_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_reckon_after_type(tokens, name, state_node(params_state), parse_path(tokens, state_index(params_state) + 1))

  reckon parse_reckon_after_type(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, params : Sequence, type_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_reckon_after_expression(name, params, state_text(type_state),
      parse_expression(tokens, state_index(type_state) + 1, 0))

  reckon parse_reckon_after_expression(name : Text, params : Sequence, return_type : Text, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(state_index(expression_state), make_reckon(name, params, return_type, state_node(expression_state)))

  reckon parse_reckon(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_reckon_after_params(tokens, token_text_at(tokens, index + 1), parse_params(tokens, index + 3, empty_sequence()))

  reckon own_facet(node : Sequence, owner : Text) -> Sequence =
    mark_input(make_facet(owner + "." + facet_path(node), facet_type(node), facet_expression(node), owner, facet_line(node), facet_column(node)), facet_input(node))

  reckon parse_owned_facet_after(owner : Text, item_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(state_index(item_state), own_facet(state_node(item_state), owner))

  reckon parse_owned_facet(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, owner : Text) -> Sequence =
    parse_owned_facet_after(owner, parse_facet(tokens, index))

  reckon make_warrant(subject : Text, capability : Text, target : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), subject), capability), target)

  reckon warrant_subject(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 0)
  reckon warrant_capability(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 1)
  reckon warrant_target(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 2)
  reckon warrant_conditional(node : Sequence) -> Truth = length(node) > 3
  reckon warrant_condition(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 3)

  reckon parse_warrant_condition(subject : Text, capability : Text, target : Text, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(state_index(expression_state), sequence_append(make_warrant(subject, capability, target), state_node(expression_state)))

  reckon parse_warrant_after_target(tokens : Sequence, subject : Text, capability : Text, target_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, state_index(target_state)) == "while",
      parse_warrant_condition(subject, capability, state_text(target_state), parse_expression(tokens, state_index(target_state) + 1, 0)),
      make_node_state(state_index(target_state), make_warrant(subject, capability, state_text(target_state))))

  reckon parse_warrant_after_capability(tokens : Sequence, subject : Text, capability_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_warrant_after_target(tokens, subject, state_text(capability_state), parse_path(tokens, state_index(capability_state) + 1))

  reckon parse_warrant(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, subject : Text) -> Sequence =
    parse_warrant_after_capability(tokens, subject, parse_path(tokens, index + 1))

  reckon make_subject_state(index : Number, name : Text, facets : Sequence, warrants : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), index), name), facets), warrants)

  reckon parse_subject_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text, facets : Sequence, warrants : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "}", make_subject_state(index + 1, name, facets, warrants),
      choose(token_text_at(tokens, index) == "facet" or token_text_at(tokens, index) == "input",
        parse_subject_after_facet(tokens, name, parse_owned_facet(tokens, index, name), facets, warrants),
        parse_subject_after_warrant(tokens, name, parse_warrant(tokens, index, name), facets, warrants)))

  reckon parse_subject_after_facet(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, item_state : Sequence, facets : Sequence, warrants : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_subject_body(tokens, state_index(item_state), name, sequence_append(facets, state_node(item_state)), warrants)

  reckon parse_subject_after_warrant(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, item_state : Sequence, facets : Sequence, warrants : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_subject_body(tokens, state_index(item_state), name, facets, sequence_append(warrants, state_node(item_state)))

  reckon parse_subject(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_subject_body(tokens, index + 3, token_text_at(tokens, index + 1), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence())

  reckon make_need(capability : Text, target : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), capability), target)

  reckon need_capability(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 0)
  reckon need_target(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 1)

  reckon make_alter(target : Text, expression : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), target), expression)

  reckon alter_target(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 0)
  reckon alter_expression(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(node, 1)

  reckon make_rule(kind : Text, name : Text, cause : Text, from_subject : Text, into_subject : Text, when_expression : Sequence, needs : Sequence, preserves : Sequence, alters : Sequence, witnesses : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), kind), name), cause), from_subject), into_subject), when_expression), needs), preserves), alters), witnesses)

  reckon rule_kind(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 0)
  reckon rule_name(node : Sequence) -> Text = sequence_get(node, 1)
